session_policy: One fresh session per author, blind solver, or reviewer request; one persistent loopback server; tools and plugins disabled.

calibration.input: Exactly single-line-context-v2 serialize_state_bounded output with the pinned q25 tokenizer and 1024 input-token limit. No gold, objective, or extra task instruction.
calibration.output: The provider may write prose before a final block. The final block is exactly a line containing <FINAL_ACTION>, a line containing one raw N/D/R/I wire action, and a line containing </FINAL_ACTION>, with no trailing text. Require exactly one opening and closing tag, no CR, no extra wire lines, and a complete provider finish=stop. Count extracted wire plus hypothetical q25 EOS against the 64-token scope cap. Record raw-wire validity separately; prior v1 narrated outputs remain invalid.
calibration.fixed_instruction: After reading the supplied editor state, you may reason briefly outside the final block. End your response with exactly these three lines: <FINAL_ACTION> then one N, D, R<TAB>line, or I<TAB>line action, then </FINAL_ACTION>. Use a real tab after R or I. Do not put Markdown, JSON, additional text, or a blank line inside or after the block.

author.input: One pinned public-source seed with its source and an author-only focus. The author sees no hidden evaluation answer.
author.output: Exactly one JSON object with keys prior_edit, target_row, action, intent_evidence, objective. prior_edit has row, old_text, new_text and must replace an existing line of the seed exactly. action has canonical kind keep/replace_line/delete_line/insert_before and text only for line actions. The objective must describe a checkable property grounded in the visible source and prior edit. No full source copy, prose wrapper, code fence, or extra keys.

blind_solver.input: Only the canonical serialized EditState after the validated prior edit; no author focus, gold action, objective, provenance, split, or future state.
blind_solver.output: One raw N/D/R/I wire action, complete and within the q25 64-token action scope.

reviewer.input: The public candidate state, proposed action, blind-solver action, and objective specification, with no author session context.
reviewer.output: Strict JSON accept/reject with a concise checkable reason and ambiguity flag. It cannot rewrite a failed objective or change the gold action.

initial_pilot.training_acceptance: Byte-exact prior edit replay and target application, in-scope token length, public license provenance, blind solver result, independent objective, and reviewer outcome must all be recorded. Agreement alone is not objective validity.
